decision: Required to start the Sprint from the pit lane.
fact: The setup of the suspension has been changed while under parc fermé without the approval of the Technical Delegate.
offence: Breaches of Articles B3.5.3 and B3.5.4 of the FIA F1 Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the Sprint from the pit lane.
reason: Atlassian Williams F1 Team changed the setup of the suspension of Car 55 under parc fermé before the start of the Sprint, without the approval of the Technical Delegate. This is not accordance with Article B3.5.4 of the FIA F1 Regulations. In addition, the change of setup is not in accordance with Article B3.5.3 of the FIA F1 Regulations. Car 55 is therefore required to start the Sprint from pit lane as per Article B3.5.3b of the FIA F1 Regulations.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
evidence presented. ### Felix Holter Matthew Selley ### Pedro Lamy Paul Ng
